instruction: Ensure VS Code installs the Python extension automatically and assigns Python 3 as the default interpreter when starting new workspaces.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because it requires automatic extension installation and interpreter configuration on VS Code launch, which involves manipulating VS Code's extension marketplace API and workspace-level settings in an automated initialization context. The environment cannot control VS Code's extension installation process or set up automatic initialization routines that trigger on launch. This goes beyond what can be achieved through desktop automation.
metadata.infeasible_reason: Requires automatic VS Code extension installation and interpreter configuration on launch which is not supported
